comments.content: [medium] Consistent with the earlier fixes made to the node merging logic, the same idiom should be applied here: prefer building a new combined collection instead of mutating the existing one, e.g. `edge0_attrs["keywords"] = list(set(edge0_attrs["keywords"] + edge1_attrs["keywords"]))`. This improves readability and cuts down on mutation-related confusion.
[low] Consider recording the relevant `merging_nodes` value only when it is safe to expose in diagnostics.
[low] Consider moving the `.nodes` assumption into an explicit validation step before this work begins.
